name: Valley Gardens Play Area
description: A play area refurbished in the council's Big Parks and Play Area Project, with a wheelchair-friendly roundabout, a transfer-height seesaw, a nest swing, a junior multi-play unit, a track ride and play panels (completed November 2025).
